nodes.name: vitest.config.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest configuration for the JARVIS HUD frontend package, specifying the test runner environment and framework settings.

nodes.name: latest_snapshot.json
nodes.summary: The most recent published trading snapshot containing tier-1 and tier-2 series values, quality summary, guard results, revision policy, and system metadata. Used as the canonical current snapshot artifact.
nodes.languageNotes: 21 top-level keys including snapshot_id, verdict, guards, tier1_series, tier2_series, values_by_group, and quality_summary — a denormalized snapshot of the full system state.

nodes.name: query_db.py
nodes.summary: CLI tool for inspecting the SQLite observations database, providing subcommands for listing tables, viewing series data, checking freshness, comparing series, exporting to CSV, and browsing snapshot history.

nodes.name: cmd_freshness
nodes.summary: Displays per-series data freshness status by comparing the latest observation timestamps against expected staleness thresholds from the series registry.

nodes.name: cmd_registry
nodes.summary: Lists all series from the series registry with tier, group, and metadata, providing a human-readable overview of the registered data sources.

nodes.name: cmd_series
nodes.summary: Queries and displays historical observations for a specific series with optional date range filtering and tail limit.

nodes.name: cmd_compare
nodes.summary: Renders a side-by-side tabular comparison of multiple time series aligned on the same timestamps.

nodes.name: cmd_snapshots
nodes.summary: Lists the most recent trading snapshots from the database with verdict, guard results, and flags.

nodes.name: cmd_snapshot_detail
nodes.summary: Shows detailed contents of a specific snapshot including tier-grouped series values and quality metadata.

nodes.name: cmd_status
nodes.summary: Prints a database health summary showing series counts, total observations, latest snapshot metadata, and per-series staleness status.

nodes.name: parse_args
nodes.summary: Builds and parses the argparse CLI argument specification for all query_db subcommands.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point that dispatches to the appropriate subcommand handler based on parsed arguments.

nodes.name: run_backfill.py
nodes.summary: Orchestration script that runs one or more data-source adapters to backfill historical observations into the SQLite database, supporting windowed and full-history modes.

nodes.name: run_all
nodes.summary: Runs all specified adapters sequentially, building appropriate CLI argument lists for window or full-history mode and collecting per-adapter results.

nodes.name: _window_args
nodes.summary: Constructs adapter-specific CLI arguments for a date-windowed backfill by mapping adapter names to their expected parameter formats.

nodes.name: _print_summary
nodes.summary: Logs a structured summary of backfill results by adapter, reporting successes, warnings, and failures.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point for the backfill runner — parses arguments, validates inputs, selects adapters, and invokes run_all with timing.

nodes.name: snapshot_publisher.py
nodes.summary: Core snapshot publication pipeline that reads the observation database, runs quality gates, computes a deterministic snapshot ID, writes the snapshot to the database, and exports it as JSON.

nodes.name: _write_snapshot
nodes.summary: Persists a snapshot record and its associated series values into the database within a single transaction.

nodes.name: _minimal_quality_check
nodes.summary: Fallback quality gate that checks Tier-1 series freshness against the observation database when the full quality gate module is unavailable.

nodes.name: compute_snapshot_id
nodes.summary: Deterministically computes a content-addressed snapshot ID by hashing clock timestamp, engine version, config version, and sorted series values.

nodes.name: write_snapshot_json
nodes.summary: Serializes the full snapshot payload — including tier-grouped values, guards, revision policy, and quality summary — to a JSON file.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point for the snapshot publisher — manages the full publish lifecycle including quality gate, snapshot existence check, database write, and JSON export.

nodes.name: snapshot.json
nodes.summary: Placeholder or working-copy snapshot JSON file in the snapshot_sources directory, used as a staging target by the snapshot publisher.

nodes.summary: Python package initializer for the src.risk module, making the risk management subsystem importable as a package.

nodes.summary: Python package initializer for the src.supervisor module, making the supervisor subsystem importable as a package.

nodes.name: sync_to_neo4j.py
nodes.summary: ETL script that parses all dev_graph Markdown nodes (frontmatter + wikilinks + relationship sections) and synchronizes them as nodes and edges into the Neo4j graph database, enabling graph-based querying of the engineering knowledge graph.

nodes.name: parse_dev_graph_file
nodes.summary: Parses a single dev_graph Markdown file into a structured node representation including frontmatter, extracted wikilinks, and parsed relationship sections.

nodes.name: sync_to_neo4j
nodes.summary: Connects to Neo4j, optionally clears existing DevGraph nodes and relationships, then bulk-inserts all parsed nodes and their resolved edges using generated Cypher statements.

nodes.name: verify_graph
nodes.summary: Runs validation queries against the Neo4j graph to report node counts, edge counts, orphan nodes, and isolated canonical nodes after a sync.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point for the Neo4j sync script — parses arguments and orchestrates the scan, sync, and optional verification steps.

nodes.name: test_execution_bench.py
nodes.summary: Test suite validating the execution benchmark harness for determinism, byte-identical replay, corpus grounding, fill distribution, idempotency, guard attribution, and artifact consistency.

nodes.name: test_execution_determinism.py
nodes.summary: Tests that the execution engine produces byte-identical results across replays and preserves state hash through persist/load round-trips.

nodes.name: test_execution_engine.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the execution engine covering fill logic, position accumulation, guard blocking, idempotency, input validation, and execution record invariants.

nodes.name: test_execution_guards.py
nodes.summary: Tests for execution guard logic including position-size blocking, withdrawal-enabled blocking, fill suppression, and config override behavior.

nodes.name: test_feature_builder.py
nodes.summary: Tests for the feature builder verifying correct feature set construction, value accuracy, provenance propagation, determinism, and handling of missing input series.

nodes.name: test_decision_builder.py
nodes.summary: Comprehensive tests for the gold decision builder covering golden-file comparisons, byte-identical replay, policy fingerprinting, guard reference passthrough, and config validation.

nodes.name: test_e2e_pipeline.py
nodes.summary: End-to-end pipeline tests that verify byte-identical replay, golden packet output, snapshot provenance propagation, and snapshot ID flow through the full trading decision pipeline.

nodes.name: test_gold_bench.py
nodes.summary: Tests for the gold benchmark harness checking determinism, byte-identical replay, pinned pass-packet values, direction reachability, and artifact sync.

nodes.name: test_paper_runtime_bench.py
nodes.summary: Tests for the paper-trading runtime benchmark harness covering determinism, byte-identical replay, idempotency, verdict reachability, and artifact sync.

nodes.name: test_paper_runtime_determinism.py
nodes.summary: Tests that the paper-trading runtime produces byte-identical records across runs and that policy fingerprints are stable and correctly bound into record IDs.

nodes.name: test_paper_runtime_engine.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the paper-trading runtime engine covering admit/reject logic, guard ordering, operational state checks, config defaults, and record invariants.

nodes.name: test_paper_runtime_guards.py
nodes.summary: Tests for paper-trading runtime guards covering duplicate detection, operational state checks, venue conditions, and snapshot provenance echoing.
